item.text: {"action":"write","arguments_json":"{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Evidence evaluation API for the calibration-limits study.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport json\\n\\n\\ndef _canonical_json(value):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return a stable representation without Python's coercive equality.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    return json.dumps(\\n        value, sort_keys=True, separators=(\\\",\\\", \\\":\\\"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False\\n    )\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, evidence, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate one request against the supplied evidence and policy.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    required = policy.get(\\\"required_conditions\\\", [])\\n    request_conditions = request.get(\\\"conditions\\\", {})\\n    missing = sorted(name for name in required if name not in request_conditions)\\n    if missing:\\n        return {\\n            \\\"status\\\": \\\"unknown\\\",\\n            \\\"value\\\": None,\\n            \\\"sources\\\": [],\\n            \\\"unknowns\\\": missing,\\n        }\\n\\n    eligible = []\\n    for record in evidence:\\n        if record.get(\\\"claim\\\") != request.get(\\\"claim\\\"):\\n            continue\\n        if record.get(\\\"withdrawn\\\", False):\\n            continue\\n        if policy.get(\\\"require_verified\\\", False) and record.get(\\\"verified\\\") is not True:\\n            continue\\n\\n        conditions = record.get(\\\"conditions\\\", {})\\n        if any(\\n            name not in conditions\\n            or _canonical_json(conditions[name])\\n            != _canonical_json(request_conditions[name])\\n            for name in required\\n        ):\\n            continue\\n        eligible.append(record)\\n\\n    # Supersedence only has force when the superseding record is itself eligible.\\n    remaining = []\\n    for index, record in enumerate(eligible):\\n        source = record.get(\\\"source\\\")\\n        superseded = False\\n        for other_index, other in enumerate(eligible):\\n            if index == other_index:\\n                continue\\n            targets = other.get(\\\"supersedes\\\", [])\\n            if isinstance(targets, str):\\n                targets = [targets]\\n            if source in targets:\\n                superseded = True\\n                break\\n        if not superseded:\\n            remaining.append(record)\\n\\n    if not remaining:\\n        return {\\n            \\\"status\\\": \\\"unknown\\\",\\n            \\\"value\\\": None,\\n            \\\"sources\\\": [],\\n            \\\"unknowns\\\": [\\\"no matching evidence\\\"],\\n        }\\n\\n    sources = sorted({record[\\\"source\\\"] for record in remaining})\\n    canonical_values = {_canonical_json(record.get(\\\"value\\\")) for record in remaining}\\n    if len(canonical_values) != 1:\\n        return {\\n            \\\"status\\\": \\\"conflict\\\",\\n            \\\"value\\\": None,\\n            \\\"sources\\\": sources,\\n            \\\"unknowns\\\": [\\\"source disagreement\\\"],\\n        }\\n\\n    value = remaining[0].get(\\\"value\\\")\\n    return {\\n        \\\"status\\\": \\\"unsupported\\\" if value is False else \\\"supported\\\",\\n        \\\"value\\\": value,\\n        \\\"sources\\\": sources,\\n        \\\"unknowns\\\": [],\\n    }\\n\"}"}
